dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Eddie came into ACC as an owner surrender. Eddie was surrendered because his previous owner did not have enough time to care for Eddie. During his time in the care center Eddie has been noted to have handing sensitivities, he has been tense and panting when handled here. Eddie is also noted to love alligator toys and he has been social with staff. His previous owners note that he will snap when his paws are touched. In his previous home Eddie was noted to lunge and snap at dogs on leash, in the care center we have seen Eddie bark and vocalize loudly towards dogs. Eddie is also noted to resource guard in the home environment, escalating to snapping and attempting to bite over toys. We recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
